result:
Edits are in, typecheck is clean, and the full suite passes (73 files, 616 tests).

Files changed:
- `src/lib/mentions.ts`: handles resolve against active members only, viewers included, and a shared handle resolves to every member who has it.
- `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`: optional `subject` so the posting bucket is per member.
- `src/types/event.ts`: new `comment.edited` event.
- `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`: mentions read from all active members, author excluded; posting limit charged per member; edit window measured from `createdAt`; edits re-read mentions and emit `comment.edited`; a reply's parent must belong to the same issue.
- `src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts`: thread includes all replies at any depth in posting order; deleted comments stay as redacted placeholders; `updateComment` writes the new mention list.
- `src/server/services/notification-service.ts`: each person gets one alert per comment, a mention outranks a comment alert, the reply's author is notified, and `comment.edited` alerts only newly mentioned people.
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts`: re-indexes on `comment.edited`.
- `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts`: removed the org-wide rate-limit charge.
- `src/components/domain/comment/comment-thread.tsx`: shows deleted placeholders instead of hiding them.
